meta.note: Mock detail data for Vigil protocol pages. Values grounded in mid-2026 public data (DeFiLlama, L2Beat, CoinGecko, news) but are illustrative, not live. Each signal carries a `source` and `status` so unsourceable ones can be dropped without breaking the health-score calc. Optional sections (contracts/incidents/dependencies) may be empty per protocol.
meta.signalConvention: normalized ∈ [0,1] where 1 = healthy, 0 = critical. weight = contribution to health score, normalized so weights sum to 1.0 across all signals per protocol.

identity.name: Base
identity.description: Coinbase's Ethereum L2 built on the OP Stack, part of the Optimism Superchain. Largest OP-Stack chain by TVL.

assessment.summary: Healthy activity and TVL, but the score is capped by sequencer centralization: Coinbase operates the only sequencer and a Security Council multisig retains upgrade authority (L2Beat Stage 0). The Azul upgrade cut the trustless-exit window to ~1 day, improving the withdrawal risk profile.

assessmentHistory.summary: Pre-Azul: 7-day withdrawal window weighing on exit risk.
Azul TEE+ZK proofs live; withdrawal window down to ~1 day.

risk.title: Centralized sequencer
risk.note: Coinbase runs the only sequencer. A regulatory action or operational incident at Coinbase directly affects all Base users.

risk.title: Multisig upgrade authority
risk.note: A Security Council multisig can pause or upgrade contracts (Stage 0).

risk.title: New proof stack
risk.note: Azul's dual TEE+ZK system is recent; audit coverage still maturing. TEE hardware vulnerabilities partially backstopped by ZK override.

risk.title: Ethereum DA
risk.note: Posts data to Ethereum via blobs — strong DA guarantees.

incidents.title: Azul mainnet activation
incidents.note: Dual TEE+ZK proof system; withdrawal window cut 7d → ~1d.

dependencies.note: Settles to and posts DA on Ethereum.
Shares OP Stack code + Superchain fee agreement with Optimism Collective.

askSuggestions: What happens to my positions if the Base sequencer goes down?
How much did Azul actually reduce exit risk?
Why is Base capped at Stage 0 and what would move it to Stage 1?

identity.name: Aave
identity.description: Largest DeFi lending protocol. V3 across 21+ chains, V4 hub-and-spoke rolling out. Issues the GHO stablecoin; backstopped by the Safety Module.

assessment.summary: Fundamentally sound and deeply liquid, but the score sits at the top of the caution band. TVL is down ~52% from the November 2025 peak, partly from April's KelpDAO contagion, and an active governance dispute over Aave Labs funding adds uncertainty. Heavy reliance on stETH as collateral ties Aave's risk to Lido.

assessmentHistory.summary: Near peak TVL, all signals nominal.

risk.title: stETH concentration
risk.note: stETH is a dominant collateral asset; a Lido/stETH depeg would cascade into Aave liquidations.

risk.title: Chainlink dependency
risk.note: Pricing relies on Chainlink feeds; feed failure or manipulation is a systemic risk.

risk.title: Active funding dispute
risk.note: ACI vs Aave Labs dispute over a $51M funding vote introduces governance uncertainty.

risk.title: TVL drawdown
risk.note: Down ~52% from Nov 2025 peak; partly broad market, partly KelpDAO contagion.

triggers.reason: 7-day score decline breached the -15pt rolling threshold amid governance dispute.

incidents.title: KelpDAO exploit contagion
incidents.note: TVL fell from ~$26.4B to ~$14.3B over days as leveraged/restaking collateral unwound.

dependencies.note: stETH is a major collateral asset.
Primary deployment; V3 also on 21+ chains incl. Base.

askSuggestions: Why did Aave's score drop this week?
How exposed is Aave to a Lido / stETH depeg?
Is the governance dispute a real risk to my deposits?

identity.name: Uniswap
identity.description: Largest DEX by volume. V4 adds Hooks + singleton architecture; ~half of V4 volume now runs on Unichain, Uniswap's own L2. Protocol fee switch activated late 2025.

assessment.summary: Strong and improving. The December 2025 fee switch (17% of fees now buy back and burn UNI, extended to L2s through 2026) finally links protocol usage to token value, and V4 volume is healthy. Main watch item is volume concentration on Unichain, a self-dependency, plus per-pool risk introduced by custom V4 Hooks.

assessmentHistory.summary: Pre-fee-switch; token value disconnected from usage.
Fee switch live and extending to L2s; sentiment up.

risk.title: Unichain dependency
risk.note: ~Half of V4 volume runs on Uniswap's own L2; an issue there concentrates impact.

risk.title: V4 hook surface
risk.note: Hooks let anyone inject custom code into pool lifecycle — per-pool risk varies widely.

risk.title: Fee-switch precedent
risk.note: Turning on protocol fees has historically raised securities-treatment questions for governance tokens.

risk.title: Volume cyclicality
risk.note: Revenue now tied to volume, which is volatile with market conditions.

incidents.title: Fee switch activated (Ethereum)
incidents.note: 17% of fees redirected to buy back and burn UNI; extended to L2s (Mar 2026) and more chains (Jun 2026).

dependencies.note: Primary deployment; multichain incl. Base, Unichain.
Uniswap's own L2 carries ~half of V4 volume.

askSuggestions: How does the fee switch change UNI's value accrual?
What's the risk from V4 hooks in the pools I'd be exposed to?
How dependent is Uniswap on Unichain now?

identity.name: Lido
identity.description: Largest Ethereum liquid-staking protocol; stETH is the most widely integrated LST and a dominant collateral asset across DeFi. Dual Governance protects stETH holders from contentious LDO votes.

assessment.summary: Operationally strong: TVL up ~27% over 30 days, stETH holding peg, zero slashing events, and Dual Governance in place as a stETH-holder backstop. Two structural watch items: staking market share is slipping toward large institutional entrants, and stETH's role as ubiquitous collateral makes any depeg a systemic, cross-protocol event.

assessmentHistory.summary: Market-share decline as BitMine/Grayscale enter staking.
TVL recovery; buyback program and Dual Governance supportive.

risk.title: Ubiquitous collateral
risk.note: stETH is collateral across Aave, Sky and 100+ protocols; a depeg propagates system-wide.

risk.title: Staking share erosion
risk.note: Share of staked ETH declining as BitMine, Grayscale and others enter.

risk.title: Operator concentration
risk.note: Historically concentrated operator set; CSM is decentralizing it but exposure remains.

risk.title: LDO value accrual
risk.note: LDO is 94.7% off ATH with weak direct claim on rewards; buybacks are new.

incidents.title: 15% workforce reduction
incidents.note: Cost optimization, framed as not performance-driven.

incidents.title: Canonical wstETH bridge revocations
incidents.note: Revoked canonical bridge status on several L2s (zkSync Era, Mode, Scroll, etc.).

askSuggestions: What would a stETH depeg do to the rest of my portfolio?
Is Lido's declining staking share a real risk?
How protected am I as a stETH holder under Dual Governance?

identity.name: Sky (MakerDAO)
identity.description: Longest-running crypto-collateralized stablecoin issuer. Rebranded from MakerDAO to Sky in Aug 2024 (DAI→USDS 1:1, MKR→SKY 1:24,000). Backs ~$13B of USDS+DAI with crypto vaults, a USDC Peg Stability Module, and $1.5B+ of tokenized US Treasuries.

assessment.summary: Stable and revenue-diversified: RWA Treasuries are now the largest income source, insulating Sky from crypto-only volatility, and USDS/DAI hold peg. The trade-off is trust surface — RWA counterparty exposure (Monetalis, BlockTower) and USDC pass-through risk via the Peg Stability Module both introduce off-chain and centralized dependencies a pure crypto-backed dollar wouldn't have.

assessmentHistory.summary: RWA share growing; peg stable, SSR at 3.75%.
Obex RWA mandate deployment; revenue diversified.

risk.title: RWA off-chain trust
risk.note: Tokenized Treasuries rely on off-chain custodians (Monetalis, BlockTower). Partner default would erode the surplus and could force a USDS haircut.

risk.title: USDC pass-through (PSM)
risk.note: The Peg Stability Module holds significant USDC; a USDC depeg passes straight through to USDS.

risk.title: Crypto liquidation cascade
risk.note: A large crypto drawdown could trigger vault liquidation cascades against the surplus.

risk.title: SKY migration in progress
risk.note: MKR→SKY migration ongoing; passive MKR holders unaffected but governance increasingly assumes SKY.

incidents.title: MakerDAO → Sky
incidents.note: DAI→USDS (1:1), MKR→SKY (1:24,000); SubDAOs became Stars (Spark first).

incidents.title: Binance DAI→USDS auto-conversion
incidents.note: Largest exchange-level stablecoin conversion; DAI pairs delisted in favor of USDS.

dependencies.note: USDC held in the PSM backs part of the peg.
Core deployment; USDS also on Base, Solana.

askSuggestions: What happens to USDS if one of the RWA partners defaults?
How exposed is Sky to a USDC depeg through the PSM?
Is my sUSDS position safe in a crypto liquidation cascade?
